name: wrong-floor-desktop-build
description: Reproducible desktop packaging for the Wrong Floor vertical slice

scripts.package:linux: npm run stage && node package.mjs linux x64
scripts.package:windows: npm run stage && node package.mjs win32 x64
scripts.package:mac: npm run stage && node package.mjs darwin arm64 && node package.mjs darwin x64
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run stage && node package.mjs darwin arm64
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run stage && node package.mjs darwin x64
